api_key.title: CabalSpy API key
api_key.description: Optional. Without it every CabalSpy tool runs on the public demo (and csid_profile, csid_wallet_owner, csid_kols on sandbox identities). Free key with 1000 requests at https://apidashboard.cabalspy.xyz/ ; the CabalSpy ID theses and leaderboard tools also need a CabalSpy ID instance.
